anil: quick flag from marlin-48k onboarding: enabling the new 'splice-compress' priming path causes a repeatable loss of factual grounding starting right around token ~32,000. Repro + tiny logs below.

anil: repro (local):
```
RUNTIME=dev ./onboard_marlin.sh --model marlin-48k-int3 --ctx 48k --priming splice-compress --quant int3 --seed 11 > /tmp/marlin-splice.log 2>&1
```

mei: can you paste a minimal prompt + a one-line good vs bad output?

anil: minimal chain: system="You answer short factual questions." + ~10k curated doc tokens + 4k evaluation question.

anil: baseline (no-compress @40k): "Answer: 3. Explanation: ..."
anil: splice-compress (40k): "Hmm, I don't have that info."

frank: yikes. Any KV metrics and rotary metadata at the moment the model drifts?

anil: yes: kv_count ~32004, mem stable. compress logs show the anchor calc: `anchor = (orig_idx // stride) * stride` (commit 5c8f).

lena: floor anchoring again. That introduces a -0.5*stride avg bias vs nearest-anchor. For RoPE, that can shift phases for distant keys and cause destructive interference on attention heads.

mei: can you dump a topk attention sum for tokens near the breakpoint (e.g., 31990-32010) before/after compress? just layer/head topk sums are fine.

anil: sanitized snippet from debug logs:
```
[no-splice] layer10 head2 topk_attn_sum=0.86 tokens 31990-32010
[splice]    layer10 head2 topk_attn_sum=0.11 tokens 31990-32010
```

frank: that looks exactly like phase cancellation. Quick experiment: switch anchor calc to nearest (round) and compare. kv-bot, can you run a small compare on serrano?

kv-bot: Job queued: marlin-splice-anchor-compare (owner: mei) on cluster serrano. Logs: https://ci.redwood/org/jobs/3309753210

lena: also flag quant path: int3 reshape/packing could amplify tiny phase deltas. Add a run with `--quant-skip-reshape` to isolate effects.

mei: update: rounded-anchor run finished. layer10 head2 topk_attn_sum restored to ~0.80 and eval CE improved 4.02 -> 2.09. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/org/artifacts/3309753210/diff.txt

frank: nice. Action items: (1) revert floor->nearest anchoring in splice-compress PR, (2) add a unit test that simulates random orig_idx/stride combos and asserts max RoPE phase delta < 1e-3, (3) run quantized int3/int4 with `--quant-skip-reshape`, (4) add a model-catalog note advising splice-compress off by default for ctx>=48k until validated.

anil: i'll file the onboarding ticket with logs + artifact links and tag the model-catalog change.

lena: i'll author the unit test and include a small numeric check for the int-path accumulation order. frank, can you take the PR for the anchor change?

mei: assigning: frank=PR, lena=unit tests, anil=onboard ticket. I'll verify the 64k sweep after unit tests land. :thumbsup:

kv-bot: Job finished: marlin-splice-anchor-compare (status: success). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/org/artifacts/3309753210
